        curr_r, curr_c = dot[0] + dr, dot[1] + dc
        steps = 0

        while 0 <= curr_r < H and 0 <= curr_c < W:

            curr_c += dc

            cr, cc = dot[0] + dr, dot[1] + dc
            while grid[cr][cc] != 8:
                grid[cr][cc] = dot[2]
                cr += dr
                cc += dc
